A mailto link is extracted into metadata.links when extract_metadata is true

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>Contact <a href="mailto:hello@example.com">us</a> directly.</p>', HtmlToMarkdownRs::ConversionOptions.new(extract_metadata: true))
puts result.content.inspect
puts result.metadata.links.inspect
```
